palette_rationale: Anchor the 16px palette to the reviewed Idle: keep Dracmon's violet and green eye shapes, white eye glints, light hand surfaces, and red finger/foot markings. Do not invent pupils, eyelids, mouth colors, or effects.
reference: Own DSTS chr457 model and native clips; PMDO registry supplies action names and timing fields.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native buoyant forward cycle; endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native hand-led strike with distinct windup and side contact.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native front-facing expression and hand raise; no projectile asset.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native resting crouch; source eyes appear open in the audition.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native ordinary recoil; bf01 and deeper bd variants are more extreme.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native arm sweep, preserving the colored hand and finger anatomy.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two repeats of the native strike; PMDO has only one HitFrame field.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Native alternate hand-raised action; inspect actual shadow separation after packing.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native anticipation and reverse-sampled recovery; no aura or effect added.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native gaze clip with whole-view yaw for the PMDO rotate cycle; endpoint excluded.
